title: Optimize config versions: add list/get endpoints with cursor pagination + filtering
author: Chloe Martin
body: Implements the list/get endpoints for Optimize config versions with pagination + filtering, and aligns response shapes to what Console needs for the version history timeline and compare entrypoint. This builds on the version store scaffolding from PR #10432 and is intended to unblock Console work (ENG-4825/ENG-4826). Endpoints: GET /v1/optimize/config-versions (list) and GET /v1/optimize/config-versions/{version_id} (get). Listing supports scope filters (customer_id, deployment_mode, environment, region, cluster, route_id, model_id) and time bounds (created_after/created_before). Pagination is cursor-based using page_size + page_token; ordering is stable on (created_at DESC, version_id DESC) to avoid duplicates/holes during concurrent writes. Response includes minimal metadata for timeline rendering (version_id, scope, created_at, created_by, source, reason, linked_ticket, status) plus a lightweight summary for the list view (change_summary + knobs_touched). The full config blob is intentionally not returned from list; Console should call GET by version_id to fetch config_yaml + normalized_json for compare. Auth: enforces existing tenant scoping and requires Optimize read permission (temporary gate uses canReadOptimizeConfig() until ENG-4830 lands; see notes below). Tests: adds integration tests for paging correctness (including concurrent insert simulation), filter combinations, and tenant isolation. Notes/known gaps: (1) RBAC permission strings are placeholder to avoid blocking this PR; follow-up in ENG-4830 will swap to optimize.config.read. (2) Diff payload is not part of this PR; compare will use get endpoint + client-side diff until server-side diff lands in ENG-4824.
commits: optimize-config: implement listVersions query with cursor pagination
api: add GET /v1/optimize/config-versions with filters + validation
db: add index to support scope + created_at ordering
tests: integration coverage for pagination, filters, and tenant isolation
docs: update internal API README with examples + error codes
